repos_data.description: CLI and MCP server for PNTR — free *.pntr.dev subdomains with DNS, disposable email, and AI-native management

Disposable email (temp mail) CLI + MCP server for AI agents. Spawn a throwaway inbox, wait for the OTP verification code, toss it. --json on every command, exit codes 0-4, no sign-up, no API keys. Node 18+, Homebrew, npm, npx, GitHub Action.
